title: UN/LOCODE-paikkakoodit — Varsinais-Suomi (satamat, lentoasemat, terminaalit)
description: UN/LOCODE-paikkakoodit Varsinais-Suomin maakunnassa, Suomessa (96 koodia). All 96 UN/LOCODE entries for the Finnish region of Varsinais-Suomi (Finland Proper), extracted from the national fi-unlocode register by filtering on UN/LOCODE's own Subdivision column (FI-19). Each record carries the LOCODE, place name with and without diacritics, function classifiers (sea port, rail, road, airport, postal, multimodal), approval status, IATA code and coordinates, all verbatim from the source. Note: Finland is bilingual and the official UNECE list carries separate rows per language name variant (e.g. Helsinki/Helsingfors), so some LOCODEs appear twice with Finnish and Swedish names; both rows are preserved.
